Our delivery methodology for the Provincial Health Department will implement an integrated HMIS across four tertiary-care hospitals through a controlled, site-by-site rollout that protects clinical continuity while standardizing workflows and data. TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd is SECP incorporated, FBR-registered with Active Taxpayer (ATL) status, and holds ISO 27001, ISO 9001, and CMMI Level 3, with PMP-certified project managers leading delivery [CO-PROFILE]. We evidence recent hospital IT deployments for government and international clients completed within the last five years [CAP-018][CAP-030].

We will execute in five stages:
1) Discovery & solution blueprint: clinical/administrative workflow mapping for OPD/IPD, EMR, pharmacy/inventory, billing/insurance, and reporting; interface and legacy-system assessment.
2) Architecture & security-by-design: role-based access control, audit trails, and encryption aligned to our ISO 27001-certified operating practices [CO-PROFILE].
3) Build/configuration & integration: we will implement HL7 v2.x and FHIR R4 interfaces for LIS/RIS, PACS, and analyzers; our project library does not yet evidence prior HL7/FHIR delivery, and we will address this via dedicated interoperability specialists and verified interface testing prior to go-live.
4) Structured legacy data migration: extract–transform–load with documented validation, reconciliation, and sign-off per department.
5) Cutover, stabilization, and scale: pilot at the first site, then replicate to remaining hospitals using a repeatable playbook proven on multi-month hospital deployments [CAP-006][CAP-042].

Training and change management will deliver structured end-user and administrator training for ~1,200 staff with role-based curricula and competency checks. Post-implementation, we will provide three years of support with an in-country service desk and defined SLAs consistent with our operating model (24–48h response) [CO-PROFILE], and we will establish monitoring, DR procedures, and monthly availability reporting to meet the Department’s 99.5% and 4-hour RTO requirements.

Mandatory gap: we do not hold CMMI Level 5; our current appraisal is CMMI Level 3 [CO-PROFILE].
